# Synthetic media fixtures

These small, non-customer fixtures were generated for MED-001–004 tests.
Images: sharp, a solid `#26a78e` 96 × 64 RGB canvas encoded as PNG/JPEG/WebP.
Video: `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=green:s=96x64:d=2 -an -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart sample.mp4`.
No customer content, product claims or external copyrighted media are included.
